card.name: Headline-starting verbs in web link lists
card.fires_on: The first word of a headline or sentence in lists of web article links or in direct address, often a verb or modal like Should, Watch, try or consider. Seen mostly in science, space and education pages.

modes.label: Headline opener
modes.description: A modal or imperative verb starting a linked headline in a list.
modes.example: - Giant black hole may be cooking up meals -<< Watch>> a 'ring of fire' solar eclipse

modes.description: A verb that opens a spoken-style instruction to the reader in science writing.
modes.example: Don't<< try>> that on Earth! Even though the same
